settings.title: What are the benefits of using a Made to Measure mat?
settings.row_content:
Custom Fit: Made-to-measure entrance mats are tailored to fit the specific dimensions of your entrance area. This ensures maximum coverage and protection against dirt, moisture, and debris tracked into the building.

Enhanced Appearance: These mats can be customized in terms of size, shape, color, and design, allowing you to create a welcoming entrance that complements your building's aesthetic.

Improved Safety: Properly fitting entrance mats help prevent slips, trips, and falls by providing a stable surface for foot traffic, especially in areas prone to wet or slippery conditions.

Longevity and Durability: Custom-made mats are typically constructed with high-quality materials that are selected based on the specific requirements of the entrance area. This ensures durability and longevity, even in high-traffic environments.

Cost-Effectiveness: While custom-made mats may have a higher upfront cost compared to standard-sized mats, their tailored fit and enhanced performance can lead to long-term cost savings by reducing cleaning and maintenance expenses, as well as minimizing damage to interior flooring.

settings.title: How do I choose and order the right custom mat?
settings.row_content:
We at Ultimats manufacture thoughtfully developed and a highly effective range of mat products.

Each individual mat member has a specific function and each mat may be used separately to meet specific needs. However, when these matting partners are used in unison, they become a complete line of defense against mud, moisture, dirt and debris.

We recommend choosing a Barrier Mat for the outside to scrape-off heavy dirt, followed by a water-retaining Carpet Mat that may be placed either outside or inside, to remove moisture and fine dirt.

settings.title: Why is it important to purchase mats with borders?
settings.row_content:
1. Aesthetic Appeal: Mat borders add a decorative element to the door mat, enhancing its appearance and complementing the overall décor of the entrance area.
  2. Safety: Borders create a gradient between the floor and the top-surface of the mat, thus reducing the chance of trip and fall accidents
  3. Prevents Fraying: Borders help in preventing the edges of the mat from fraying or unraveling, thereby increasing its durability and lifespan.
  4. Enhanced Stability: The border provides additional weight and stability to the mat, preventing it from slipping or moving around when stepped on.
  5. Easy Maintenance: Borders can make it easier to lift and shake off debris from the mat, as they provide a designated area to grip and handle the mat during cleaning.

We at Ultimats border each mat using our unique double-compression bordering technology to provide the highest level of product satisfaction to the customer.

settings.title: Should a Doormat be Wider than the Door?
settings.row_content: A doormat needs to be at least as wide as your front door to be as effective as possible. If your entrance mats are of a smaller width, they will not capture the majority of dirt and moisture that comes through your door. We offer made-to-measure mats that are cut and bordered to the exact size you need, so you can find the perfect one for your premises.
